source.title: 2019 Kenya Population and Housing Census, Volume IV: Distribution of Population by Socio-Economic Characteristics
source.published: Copyright 2019, ISBN 978-9966-102-11-9 (PDF p.4); PDF file created 21 Feb 2020; KNBS upload path dated 2023/09
source.subCountyNote: KNBS sub-counties are national-government administrative units. No KNBS volume checked (I, IV) mentions constituencies. The only mapping found is in the County Government of Nyamira CIDP 2023-2027, s.1.4.3, p.9 (PDF p.24): West Mugirango = Nyamira South sub-county; Kitutu Masaba = Manga + Masaba North sub-counties; North Mugirango = Nyamira North sub-county except Kiabonyoru division; Borabu = Borabu sub-county plus Kiabonyoru division of Nyamira North. So Borabu and North Mugirango constituencies cannot be read off any Vol IV row. URL: https://maarifa.cog.go.ke/sites/default/files/2024-06/NYAMIRA%20CIDP%202023-2027.pdf

definitions.household: "a person or group of persons who reside in the same homestead/compound but not necessarily in the same dwelling unit, have same cooking arrangements, and are answerable to the same household head" (Vol IV s.1.7, p.5)
definitions.groupQuarters: "persons enumerated in collective living quarters such as army barracks and hostels in learning institutions" (Vol IV s.1.7, p.5)
definitions.dashInTables: "-" printed in a cell is stored as value null with printed "-" (KNBS uses it for zero/none; no legend found in Vol IV).

Intersex: every Total* minus (Male+Female) gap in Tables 2.2-2.4, 2.26, 2.28, 2.32 equals or is below the Vol I intersex count for that area (county 13; Borabu none printed (null in census.json), Manga 2, Masaba North 2, Nyamira North 6, Nyamira South 3). So Total* columns appear to INCLUDE intersex persons although the footnote says intersex are excluded; Male and Female columns exclude them. Our inference, not stated by KNBS.

Table 2.26: Total* exceeds with + without + not stated by 35 at county level (Borabu 2, Manga 4, Masaba North 3, Nyamira North 9, Nyamira South 17); unexplained in the source. Use the printed per cent with disability (3.3) rather than recomputing.
Table 2.34 Manga: Male 26,788 + Female 31,312 = 58,100, one more than printed Total* 58,099 (source inconsistency).
